sources.title: Communication-Efficient Learning of Deep Networks from Decentralized Data
sources.snippet: We term this decentralized approach Federated Learning. We present a practical method for the federated learning of deep networks based on iterative model averaging, and conduct an extensive empirical evaluation, considering five different model architectures and four datasets.

sources.snippet: The document proposes a technique called Federated Learning that allows training of machine learning models from decentralized data across many mobile devices without collecting all the data into a central location.
